reviews.text: Quickey quit working and luckily I found this... I like this even more because it gives thumbnails of pages to switch to and it does not pop up unobtrusively... it's right in your face where you want it.

Does not work on Helium browser which is chromium-based so it should work. The UI does not pop up. I hope the dev gets this working. It would be great and don't see another option in the available extensions.
reviews.dev_reply: Leaving a 1 star review for a feature request is not the way to do it...

reviews.text:
- switching between two recent tabs only
- no GUI appeared - the promised advanced functionality doesn't work
reviews.dev_reply: Is this true on regular websites? Only on special pages where the UI cannot render does it automatically switch to the last one.

reviews.text: How come it does not show preview thumbnail like the demo video?
reviews.dev_reply: Are you saying it switches but doesn't display the UI? On a few special Chrome pages, like this one, Chrome does not allow the UI to display - but on all regular websites it should display.

reviews.text: Did this thing stop working in latest chrome updates? It does nothing.
reviews.dev_reply: No, it should still be working? Check to make sure your shortcuts are still properly set: chrome://extensions/shortcuts

reviews.text:
option to select tabs with audio 👍👍

Is there a way for alt+q to toggle the menu?  would like to be able to mouse over to the tab i want.
On Chrome 140 on my side, the Alt+Q (or any other shortcut) works only around half of the times. The other half it will switch only between the second-to-last and the last used tab.

reviews.text: Works flawlessly on my Mac. However, I don’t see the Tab Window that’s shown on the extension page and available on Windows. Option + Q works fine, but that specific Tab Window seems to be missing.

It's awesome. 

[Feature request]: Allow the UI to scale vertically too, beyond 50-ish tabs I can barely see recent tabs

Works super well! Microsoft Edge has this behavior on Windows and I wish other browsers / operating systems had it. The only complaint is that I wish there was a way to limit the number of tabs visible like you can in Windows, but this still works really well.
reviews.dev_reply: Thanks for the nice review 😊 Limiting visible tabs is actually something I'm working on! Just trying to figure out the UX for it.

reviews.text:
Useful extension! 

Key placement is perfect.
Maybe you will be confused with Alt+Tab at first but in time you will get used to using Alt+Q. 10/10
